conviction_note: Nothing about Q3 is out yet and Bufab gives no numeric guidance, so the move is on new numbers (abs 6.5, set from the European new-numbers base and this name's last eight real print-day moves of 3-7%). findings.finding: Peers that reported Q3 2026 after Bufab last did printed strong industrial-distribution demand. OEM International (Swedish components distributor): organic growth 14%, order intake +40%, broad strength across regions, construction weak in Sweden and Finland. Fastenal (US fastener distributor, a proxy for Bufab's Americas region): Q3 daily sales +15.5%. Both against Bufab's Q2 organic growth of 5.3%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Bufab rose on its last four real print days (Q3'25 +5.41%, FY'25 +4.29%, Q1'26 +3.39%, Q2'26 +3.14%, close to close from the Yahoo tape), each on margin and organic-growth improvement. It fell -3.24% on Q2'25.
findings.original_quote: Den organiska tillväxten var 14 procent. ... Orderingången ökade 40 procent till 1 683 miljoner kronor (1 202). ... industrin utvecklades positivt på de flesta marknader, medan byggrelaterade segment fortsatt var svagare i Sverige och Finland. [Organic growth was 14 percent ... order intake rose 40 percent to SEK 1,683m (1,202) ... industry developed positively in most markets, while construction-related segments remained weaker in Sweden and Finland.]
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly priced. Bufab rose 3.2% on 2026-10-14, the Fastenal day (139.2 to 143.6), but has since given that back to 138.6, and the 5-day run-up is -2.8%. If the peer read were fully priced, the stock would be holding its October high into the print rather than drifting below where it stood before the peer prints. Only three analysts cover the name. Kept small because it is a proxy: Bufab says its own end markets (construction, kitchens and bathrooms, automotive) are weaker than OEM's.
findings.independence: Fastenal Q3 2026 release, a different company and a different source: daily sales +15.5% (https://s25.q4cdn.com/185498701/files/doc_financials/2026/Q3/Q3-2026-Earnings-Release-Final.pdf, 2026-10-14). It points the same way for the Americas leg.

findings.finding: Bufab's own trajectory: adj. EBITA margin 15.3% in Q1 and 14.7% in Q2 against a Q3 2025 comparison of 14.2%. The CEO expects gross-margin momentum to continue in 2026 and says the company is 'well on track' for its margin target, so year-on-year EBITA growth is likely, helped by acquisitions (novia's final pre-anniversary weeks, DC Iron from July).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Margin beats were bought on the last four prints (+3.1% to +5.4%).
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is the company's own stated trajectory, and the stock has re-rated from about 98 to about 139 SEK in a year. Filed near zero because it lands inside what management has told the market to expect.
findings.independence: Q1 2026 adj. EBITA 340m at 15.3% (https://storage.mfn.se/109f18fd-b5ed-4b1e-8502-4acfeb0bf63e/bufab-delarsrapport-januari-mars-2026.pdf), the same company and a different document.

findings.finding: In the Q2 report, management flagged a cautious approach among customers and somewhat increasing purchase prices from Asia, with weak construction and automotive. This is a gross-margin and demand risk for Q3, the seasonally weaker summer quarter, and it cuts against the peer read for Bufab's specific mix.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2025-07-15 print fell -3.24% on a weak-demand quarter. Otherwise gross margin has risen for about twelve quarters.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since July and mostly priced. Kept as a small offset because Bufab's construction, kitchens and bathrooms and automotive exposure is where OEM also reported weakness, and Dometic (RV/leisure) wrote down SEK 4.2bn the day before the print. If the market feared a gross-margin squeeze, the stock would have de-rated after Q2, and it did not.
findings.independence: OEM's Q3 notes construction-related segments still weaker in Sweden and Finland (https://www.placera.se/telegram/oem-orderstock-3-kv-bra-grund-for-avslut-2026-enl-vd-20261015).
